intro.scene_01: Deep within the Amazon rainforest, an ancient force awakens...
intro.scene_02: Ybytu, guardian of the winds, senses a disturbance in nature's balance.
intro.scene_03: Corrupted creatures begin to emerge, threatening the forest's harmony.
intro.scene_04: It is time to act. The Wrath of the Forest shall be unleashed.

opening.01: Ybytu's victory is only a story. But the forest he protects is real, and it bleeds every day.

news_01.01: In Minas Gerais, three thousand seedlings planted by the community itself were turned to ashes in an arson fire.

news_02.01: In Pará, the Munduruku people have denounced illegal mining for over thirty years, mining that burns their homes and poisons their rivers.

news_03.01: In Mato Grosso do Sul, 539 Guarani Kaiowá people were murdered in just sixteen years.

news_04.01: In Amapá, the invasion of a village and the killing of a leader spread terror among the Wajãpi.

news_05.01: And in the Urubu Branco Indigenous Land, wildfires devastated the territory of the Apÿawa people.

reflection.01: Sustainability is not about giving everything up. It is using without destroying, harvesting without depleting, and living while letting others live.
reflection.02: It means making sure those who come after us still find forest, rivers, and clean air to call their own.

thanks.01: Ybytu: The Wrath of the Forest is fiction, but the struggle it portrays is not.
thanks.02: This is the first version of the game, made with care and purpose.
thanks.03: Thank you for playing and for testing.

message.01: I hope this little story brought you a moment of reflection, player. There won't always be a hero to fight for the greater good; most of the time, there's only us: ordinary people, like you and me, capable of small actions.
message.02: In such a vast world, a single gesture may seem insignificant. But every small act of good, added to so many others, becomes something enormous.
message.03: Plant a tree and water it through the dry seasons. Years later, it may bear fruit for the children on the street or shelter that little bird that brightens the mornings. Walk without rushing and truly listen to the birds: feel the wind, soak up the sun, let the rain run down your face.
message.04: Life is beautiful, and nature offers all of this for free. It costs nothing to pause for a moment and live it.

ending.01:
I hope this little story brought you a moment of reflection. There won't always be a hero to fight for the greater good. Most of the time, there's only us, ordinary people like you and me, capable of small actions.

A single gesture may seem insignificant, but added to so many others it becomes something enormous. Plant a tree, truly listen to the birds, feel the wind and the sun. Life is beautiful, and nature offers all of this for free. It costs nothing to pause for a moment and live it.

Thank you for playing and for testing.

scene_01.01: The night has passed, and with it the threat.
scene_01.02: With the last spark the forest lent him, the guardian lies down upon the earth that saw him born.
scene_01.03: Now he can finally rest, and return for good to the place he always belonged.
scene_01.04: Around him, those he saved keep watch over his sleep. And the forest welcomes him back, as it always welcomes its own.
scene_01.05: Here, the story ends. Out there, it is still being written.

scene_02.01: Forest fires don't just destroy the vegetation, they cause enormous suffering to the animals that live in it. The jaguar Miranda walked nearly 100 km with burned paws, fleeing the flames of the Pantanal.

scene_03.01: And those too small simply cannot run. Every wildfire leaves cubs injured and orphaned, like this one rescued in São Paulo.

scene_04.01: The cages you broke are real. In a single operation in the backlands of Sergipe, 517 wild animals were rescued from illegal captivity, many of them threatened with extinction.

scene_05.01: Illegal hunting doesn't only kill the hunted animal: it steals the food of those who depend on it. Today jaguars suffer from the scarcity of prey in the Atlantic Forest.

scene_06.01: The forest doesn't need superheroes. It needs care and protection from everyone.

final.scene_01: With the last enemy defeated, the forest begins to recover.
final.scene_02: Ybytu feels nature's energy flowing in balance once more.
final.scene_03: Peace returns, but the guardian knows he must remain vigilant.
final.scene_04: For as long as the forest is threatened, Ybytu's Wrath stands ready.

stage_01_intro.scene_01: Ybytu arrives at the forest entrance and finds traces of destruction.
stage_01_intro.scene_02: The invaders are not far. It's time to defend this place.

stage_01_tutorial.scene_01: You woke up, huh, friend! Looks like the forest decided to give you a second chance.
stage_01_tutorial.scene_02: Use W A S D to move around.
stage_01_tutorial.scene_03: I was running from the fire and I found you.
stage_01_tutorial.scene_04: Seems you died, pal, but the spirit energy is holding your death back.
stage_01_tutorial.scene_05: You're probably still a bit confused, but since you're kind of mixed with nature now, I can talk to you.
stage_01_tutorial.scene_06: You should be able to move faster than before, but the pain won't go away.
stage_01_tutorial.scene_07: Use J K L to strike the enemies.
stage_01_tutorial.scene_08: Hey, you see that totem over there? If you interact with it, maybe some of your spirit energy comes back!

stage_01_outro.scene_01: The entrance is secure, but danger continues deeper into the forest.
stage_01_outro.scene_02: Ybytu presses further into the woods.

stage_02_intro.scene_01: In the heart of the forest, the darkness grows thicker.
stage_02_intro.scene_02: The creatures here are stronger. Ybytu must proceed with caution.

stage_02_outro.scene_01: The center is purified, but the source of corruption still exists.

stage_03_intro.scene_01: The sacred spring... is completely corrupted.
stage_03_intro.scene_02: A malevolent presence guards this place. The final confrontation approaches.

stage_03_outro.scene_01: The creature falls, and the spring begins to glow once more.
stage_03_outro.scene_02: The forest is saved... for now.
